descriptions.zh:
无知正在束缚着我们，让我们无从一窥大千世界之奥秘。

无论付出什么代价，我们都要挣脱束缚。

§R失落帝国会试图阻止我们！§!
descriptions.en:
Ignorance shackles us, putting the universe's secrets out of reach.

No matter the price, we must break free.

§RFallen Empires will try to stop us!§!

descriptions.zh:
离开的时刻到了。为了谱写我们自己的“出谷记”，需要派出视界刺针接上我们所有的人民。

为了将我们整个文明搭载到§H视界刺针§!，必须：
    —依次访问我们所有的所有殖民地，§H搭载§!其中的人口
    —返回我们的首都§H搭载§!最后一批人民。
    —前往一个黑洞并§H深潜§!进入。

§R警告§!：视界刺针没有任何武器，需要被严密保护。

§g要搭载人口或深潜入黑洞，需先选择视界刺针，然后右键点击殖民地/黑洞并选择对应的舰船行动。§!
descriptions.en:
The time of our departure has come. In preparation for the great exodus, the Horizon Needle will be sent to welcome our people onboard.

To embark our entire civilization the §HHorizon Needle§! must:
    -Visit every colony we own and §HEmbark§! its population
    -Return to our capital to §HEmbark§! the rest of our people.
    -Move to a Black Hole and §HDive§! within.

§RWARNING§!: The Horizon Needle has no weapons and needs to be carefully protected.

§gTo Embark a colony or Dive into a black hole, select the Horizon Needle, then right-click on the colony/black hole and select the appropriate ship action.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们不安于自然所给予的现状，努力地超越了有机躯体的极限。全面铺开的植入体应用只遭遇了微不足道的问题，并且都已逐一迎刃而解。绝大多数人口为全新的义体所带来的一切感到欣喜若狂。

我们正站在成就伟大的大门前，未来可期。
descriptions.en:
We refuse to settle for what nature provided, and instead strive to exceed the limits of the organic body. Our full-scale distribution of implants has encountered only minor issues, all of which can be easily resolved. The vast majority of the population is exhilarated by what their new cybernetics offer.

We truly stand on the precipice of greatness. What happens next remains to be seen.

descriptions.zh:
将所有人口进行合成化是一项巨大的工程。这必然会引起反响。在适应新常态的过程中，无数的挑战和独特的机遇无疑将影响我们日常的生活。

面对这些变化的态度将决定我们未来的社会。
descriptions.en:
Synthesization of an entire population is an undertaking of monumental proportions. There are bound to be repercussions. As we adapt to the new normal, untold challenges and unique opportunities will undoubtedly affect our daily lives.

How we confront these changes will define our society for ages to come.
